subject: Observability implementation & kickoff — CloudWave onboarding
messages:
From: Carla Nunez <carla@cloudwave.com>
To: Hannah Schmitt <hannah_schmitt@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Cc: CloudWave Ops <ops-lead@cloudwave.com>
Date: Mon, 25 Jun 2028 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Next steps for observability — dashboards & runbooks

Thanks Hannah and Marissa — great demo today. A few follow-ups from the CloudWave side so we can get started on the implementation sprint: 

- We need a proposal for the initial observability scope (dashboards, spans/tracing hooks to capture service-to-service latency, and a first-pass error taxonomy) by EOD next week.
- Our compliance team requires a short note on log retention and how audit logs for inference requests are surfaced in the Console.
- Can we confirm the on-call alert routing (PagerDuty) mapping and a runbook template for the top 10 alert classes?

I'm attaching a short infra requirements doc (CloudWave-infra-requirements.pdf) with our baseline SLOs and retention policy.

Weekly kickoff would be helpful — prefer Wed/Thu mornings PT. Let me know availability.

Thanks,
Carla Nunez
Director, Platform Engineering
CloudWave

---
(Attachment: CloudWave-infra-requirements.pdf)

From: Hannah Schmitt <hannah_schmitt@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Connor O'Brien <connor_obrien@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
Cc: Carla Nunez <carla@cloudwave.com>
Date: Mon, 25 Jun 2028 11:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Next steps for observability — dashboards & runbooks

Thanks Carla — forwarding internally to pull owners. High level plan below; I'll send a calendar poll for Wed/Thu slots once I have everyone's availability.

Quick internal notes / owners: 
- Dashboards & traces (latency, p90/p99, tail latency): Marissa (owner) + Connor (alerts)
- Error taxonomy & runbook template: Karthik (owner), Hannah (review)
- Audit/log retention / Console access: Hannah (engaging Security)

Deliverables we should commit to for the first 3-week sprint:
1) Implementation runbook and alert routing map (PagerDuty integration doc)
2) 5 standard dashboards (request latency, model error rate, throughput, token cost by route, cache hit ratio)
3) Tracing hook placement checklist for the two service tiers (frontend -> router, router -> model-host)
4) Draft error taxonomy and top-10 alert playbooks

For CloudWave's retention ask: we'll include the retention matrix with roles and audit log exposure in the runbook. I'll pull the Security brief and attach to the draft.

Action: Marissa, can you draft the sprint plan and share the obs-sprint-plan.xlsx? Connor, can you draft the initial PagerDuty routing proposal (oncall -> severity mapping)? Karthik, please start the taxonomy doc and link to the Console examples.

Thanks — I'll coordinate the kickoff meeting.

Hannah
Senior Customer Success Manager
Redwood Inference

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
To: Hannah Schmitt <hannah_schmitt@redwood.com>, Connor O'Brien <connor_obrien@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
Cc: Carla Nunez <carla@cloudwave.com>
Date: Thu, 28 Jun 2028 08:22:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Next steps for observability — dashboards & runbooks

Great — I've attached a baseline sprint plan (obs-sprint-plan.xlsx) and a short agenda for the kickoff. Highlights: 

Sprint 0 (week 0): kickoff + discovery (3 days)
- Inventory of endpoints and current telemetry (CloudWave to provide list)
- Confirm SLO targets and retention matrix

Sprint 1 (week 1): tracing + dashboards
- Add tracing hooks for router and model-host (instrumentation checklist)
- Deliver 3 priority dashboards (latency, error-rate, throughput)
- Connor to prototype PagerDuty mapping (severity -> routing)

Sprint 2 (week 2): alerting + runbooks
- Finalize error taxonomy and top-10 runbooks
- Setup alert pages and escalation paths

Notes / open questions for CloudWave:
- Are there any IP allowlists or VPC peering windows we should know about? (affects agent rollout)
- Does your compliance team require token-level redaction in logs or full request capture?

Requests to CloudWave for kickoff:
1) CSV of production endpoints and team PagerDuty services by Tues EOD
2) List of SLO owners for each service

I'll be on the kickoff and will take dashboard ownership for the first week.

Marissa Cole
Implementation Lead, CS Ops
Redwood Inference

---
(Attachment: obs-sprint-plan.xlsx)

Cc: CloudWave Ops <ops-lead@cloudwave.com>
Date: Tue, 02 Jul 2028 15:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Next steps for observability — dashboards & runbooks

Thanks Hannah and team — this looks good to me. A few quick clarifications before kickoff: 

- Retention: compliance needs 7 years for audit metadata, but we can redact request-level tokens after 90 days. We'll include the exact fields to redact in the CSV.
- On-call routing: we'll share our PagerDuty service names and escalation policies by tomorrow EOD.
- Kickoff: Wed 09:30 PT works for our team — accept the invite when you send it.

One ask: can Redwood share a sample runbook for a model error (e.g., "model-500 / inference timeout") so our SREs can review the remediation steps? If you can attach an example to the kickoff doc that would be helpful.

See you on Wed.

Carla Nunez
Director, Platform Engineering
CloudWave
